summary: Report the requested information or answer back to the user once it has been located on the screen.
preconditions: The target information or answer is visible on the current page.
steps: Locate the specific text, value, or element containing the requested answer on the page.
Optionally highlight, select, or click the text/element to confirm or copy the value.
Formulate the final response containing the exact answer or value found.

variants.when: the answer is spread across multiple sections or requires scrolling
variants.do: scroll through the page to read and compile all necessary parts of the answer before reporting

variants.when: the answer is a specific number or count
variants.do: visually count the matching items on the screen or read the total count directly from the UI

watch_for: The correct text or value is fully visible and highlighted if necessary.
completion_signal: The final answer is submitted or reported to the user.
pitfalls: Reporting an incorrect or incomplete value due to not scrolling or not verifying the exact details requested.
Including unnecessary conversational filler or multiple candidate answers instead of a single, clear answer.
